name: Alphalete - KPI Scorecard Workbook
body:
> Tracker · Alphalete · 2026-07-09

# Summary
"TAG Marketing Weekly SEO KPI System", a workbook saved in the Alphalete folder (Jul 9 2026) but built for three clients. Tabs: README, Client Report Blueprint, Alphalete Weekly, Summit Weekly, Pipeliners Weekly, Monthly Rollup.

# How it works (from the README tab)
- **Two layers:** Layer 1 is the client-facing report built in Search Atlas Report Builder (baseline, deltas, AI summary, white-label PDF). Layer 2 is this internal tracker: target vs actual, percent to goal, time spent, proof, and why any miss happened.
- **Core rules:** weekly targets are activities you control (posts, links, citations, fixes); outcomes (traffic, rankings, leads) are judged monthly because they lag 1 to 3 months; the baseline is set once and never changed; average position and local rank are lower-is-better.
- **Weekly rhythm:** set baseline once; Monday fill targets; log completed work, time and proof through the week; Friday write the client-ready summary; paste key numbers into Monthly Rollup and duplicate the tab for the next week.
- **Where each number comes from:** organic leads from GoHighLevel plus GBP calls; traffic from GA4 or Search Atlas; clicks, impressions and position from GSC; rankings from the Search Atlas rank tracker; indexed pages from GSC; GBP metrics from Search Atlas Local; referring domains from Search Atlas Site Explorer; deliverables from your own work log.

# Notes
The Oct 21 meeting changed the client-facing report direction (outcomes first, email delivery). See [Alphalete - Meeting Notes 2026-10-21](lib:brain-alphalete-meeting-notes-2026-10-21).
